mapper.insert: INSERT INTO monthly_active_users (user_id, username, stat_month, post_count, comment_count, total_score, updated_at) SELECT p.user_id, u.username, #{yearMonth}, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) as post_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.user_id = p.user_id AND DATE_FORMAT(c.created_at, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth} AND c.status = 1 ) as comment_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) * 2 + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.user_id = p.user_id AND DATE_FORMAT(c.created_at, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth} AND c.status = 1 ) as total_score, NOW() FROM posts p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth} AND p.status = 1 GROUP BY p.user_id, u.username ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE post_count = VALUES(post_count), comment_count = VALUES(comment_count), total_score = VALUES(total_score), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT mau.*, u.avatar, (COALESCE(mau.post_count, 0) * 2 + COALESCE(mau.comment_count, 0)) as total_score FROM monthly_active_users mau LEFT JOIN users u ON mau.user_id = u.id WHERE mau.stat_month = #{yearMonth} ORDER BY total_score DESC, post_count DESC
